title: Finished PRs wait hours to merge after their last commit
whatHappens: PRs with one finished commit sit 1.5 to 3.3 hours, then merge together in a burst, so idle time is 43% of all PR-hours.

fixes.text: Split each waiting PR's idle time into checks time and review time from check-run timestamps, then target the larger part

observations.text: 1-2 Nov 09:00-09:00 ET: 71 merges, 140 PR-hours, 61 idle after the last commit. 10 one-commit PRs merged 03:06-03:58 ET after waiting 1.5-3.3 h. Cause not verified.
